notes: «وَجَدْتُ بِخَطِّ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» — the Saduq read a handwritten text of Sa'd: the author of a cited document (rule 11); the handwriting is the source of the link
«حَدِيثاً أَسْنَدَهُ إِلَى اَلصَّادِقِ» names the Imam inside the chain clause: he is the last link as the one the text attributes the saying to (owner ruling 2)
the context's «RWY» reading gives only «سعد بن عبد الله»; the Imam is not in that source's chain
